name: Arch Linux Firefox Compiler Env
onCreateCommand: echo 'Server=https://archive.archlinux.org/repos/2026/08/04/$repo/os/$arch' > /etc/pacman.d/mirrorlist && pacman -Syyuu --noconfirm && pacman -S --noconfirm base-devel git sudo shadow && useradd -m -s /bin/bash vscode && echo 'vscode ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD:ALL' >> /etc/sudoers
postCreateCommand: sudo sh -c 'echo "MAKEFLAGS=\"-j2\"" >> /etc/makepkg.conf' && sudo sh -c 'echo "COMPRESSXZ=(xz -c -z --threads=2 -)" >> /etc/makepkg.conf' && sudo dd if=/dev/zero of=/tmp/swapfile bs=1M count=4096 && sudo chmod 600 /tmp/swapfile && sudo mkswap /tmp/swapfile
